item.title: Chess Slogan - King in a Corner 2 T-Shirt
item.description: Chess is a game that is played by millions of people worldwide. This game is believed to be derived from the Indian game chaturanga, sometime before the 7th century. The first generally recognized World Chess Champion, Wilhelm Steinitz, claimed his title in 1886. For me, it is the ultimate game on earth, with the amount of possible legal board positions worked out to be a factor of ten multiplied with itself, hundred and twenty times! I have created these slogans to give some credit to a great game I love and respect a lot. Hope you enjoy it too.

item.title: Bigfoot Drawn with Math: Fourier Transform Pink & Blue Gradient T-Shirt

The glowing neon nodes and epicycles visualize the complex mathematics used to draw Sasquatch. Perfect for math teachers, physics students, programmers, and anyone who loves geeky, science-themed apparel with a vaporwave or cosmic gradient aesthetic.
